From: Kevin Doe <kevin.doe@acmehealth.com>

Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test notice & initial evidence ask (Acme Health)

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our contract review we need to lock down the pen test notice language and a clear evidence cadence for SOC 2 artifacts. Attached is our standard security questionnaire and a short pen-test timing template.

Top asks up front:
- Confirm whether Redwood requires 30-days notice for an external pen test or if we can operate on a 14-day window for scoped infra.
- Who is the primary evidence owner for items in the security exhibit (logs, config snapshots, SOC2 artifacts)? We usually map to named contacts and escalation paths.
- Share your proposed evidence cadence for production logs and incident sampling so our audit team can align.

Can you route this to legal and the operations owners and let us know a target turnaround for redlines? We’re aiming to finalize the Order Form and Security Exhibit by end of July.

Thanks,
Kevin
Kevin Doe
Head of InfoSec
Acme Health

Attachments: Acme_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (pdf), pen-test-scope-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Subject: Re: Pen test notice & initial evidence ask (Acme Health)

Hi Kevin — thanks for the packet and the clear asks. Looping in Laura (legal) and Soojin (ops) so we can align on contractual language and runtime evidence ownership.

Quick answers and next steps: 
- Notice window: operations preference is 14 days for scoped, low-impact tests and 30 days for broader/production-impact exams. We’ll propose flexible language in the Security Exhibit that allows a shorter window for agreed scoped tests with a mandatory pre-test checklist and a fail-safe 30-day default if scope is unclear.
- Evidence owners: Soojin will own operational artifacts (retention/config/logs); Legal (Laura) will own attestation language and audit rights mapping. I’ll draft an "evidence ownership heatmap" that maps Acme asks to Redwood owners and delivery cadence.
- Turnaround: Laura, can you confirm legal turnaround if we share an Order Form + redline? Target for us is 5 business days for initial redline review.

I’ll attach a first-pass heatmap and a suggested pen-test window matrix by Monday.

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Trust & Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will send evidence-ownership-heatmap.csv next)

From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Kevin Doe <kevin.doe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: soojin.lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test notice & initial evidence ask (Acme Health)

Thanks Kevin and Irene — I reviewed the questionnaire and drafted a legal approach below. I’ve also attached a redline excerpt for the Security Exhibit and a short list of acceptable evidence artifacts. High-level:

1) Pen test notice and authorization:
- We will propose the following text: "Customer may conduct network-level or application-level security testing of Redwood-managed services with at least fourteen (14) days' prior written notice for scoped tests. For tests that may affect production availability or require elevated privileges, thirty (30) days' prior written notice is required. All penetration testing activities must follow Redwood's penetration testing rules of engagement and must be coordinated with Redwood security.
- Add: Customer must provide a test plan and rollback plan 72 hours before the test start for scoped tests; Redwood reserves the right to postpone if the plan poses unacceptable risk."

2) Audit rights and evidence cadence:
- We propose a tiered cadence: monthly automated evidence snapshots for retention metrics, quarterly sampling for configuration drift, and annual attestation delivery for SOC 2 artifact package (or on-demand for procurement review with 5 business day turnaround).
- Clarify that SOC 2 reports are provided under NDA/POC terms; include link to Redwood SOC report portal (we'll provide URL in final).

3) Evidence ownership and SLAs:
- Operational artifacts (logs, ephemeral snapshots, KV cache snapshots) — owner: Soojin Lee (Ops). Delivery SLA: 3 business days for standard items, 10 business days for historical/backfill requests.
- Contractual attestation and redlines — owner: Legal (Laura Bennett). Delivery SLA: 5 business days initial, escalated to 2 business days for renewals/close-of-deal.

Open questions for Acme: 
- Do you need a standing pen-test calendar slot (we can reserve a staging window quarterly) or ad-hoc scheduling per test?
- Any special data residency or on-prem inspection requirements beyond SOC 2 artifacts?

Irene — I’ll need the heatmap to attach to the redline and will push the draft into the shared folder once finalized. Kevin — we can send a marked-up Security Exhibit and Order Form that reflects these SLAs; please flag if your procurement needs the SOC 2 URL embedded in the Order Form.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: security-exhibit-redline_excerpt.docx (docx)
